scope: 0-20us off-state startup current through external VLEDLOAD only; powered logic and LED, external fault asserted
reason: Near-zero directional charge has an ill-conditioned relative denominator; preserve legacy result and add independently declared absolute error budgets.
switch_derivation: 4e-17C / 0.002 = 2e-14C; absolute and relative budgets agree at crossover
near_zero_branch: When max(abs(Qa),abs(Qb)) <= switch scale, require absolute Q difference <= 4e-17C AND max pointwise current difference <= 2pA
resolved_charge_branch: Above switch scale require original abs(Qb/Qa-1) <= 0.002; no replacement of established nonzero charge relative tests
comparison_set: All pairwise comparisons of two finest local meshes, Gear1/Gear2, global maximum steps 10ns/2ns; tolerance controls included
waveform_comparison: Interpolate piecewise linearly on union of all actual solver knots, no smoothing or current clipping
charge_integration: Piecewise linear exact zero crossings, report Qpositive, Qnegative, Qsigned separately
